triggers: a kernel on AMD CDNA4 (gfx950 / MI355X) risks the '9. rocprofv3 crashes with PyTorch's bundled rocprofiler' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on AMD CDNA4 (gfx950 / MI355X): 9. rocprofv3 crashes with PyTorch's bundled rocprofiler

problem.statement: Flash Attention head_dim=256 Pitfalls (CDNA4 / gfx950) -- 9. rocprofv3 crashes with PyTorch's bundled rocprofiler

payload.attempted: **Symptom**: `SIGABRT` with "Configuration request occurred outside of valid rocprofiler configuration period".
payload.lesson: 9. rocprofv3 crashes with PyTorch's bundled rocprofiler

established_fact.mechanism: 9. rocprofv3 crashes with PyTorch's bundled rocprofiler

implementation.snippet:
```bash
TORCH_LIB=$(python -c "import torch,os; print(os.path.dirname(torch.__file__))")/lib
mv $TORCH_LIB/librocprofiler-register.so $TORCH_LIB/librocprofiler-register.so.orig
mv $TORCH_LIB/librocprofiler-sdk.so $TORCH_LIB/librocprofiler-sdk.so.orig
ln -s /opt/rocm/lib/librocprofiler-register.so $TORCH_LIB/librocprofiler-register.so
ln -s /opt/rocm/lib/librocprofiler-sdk.so $TORCH_LIB/librocprofiler-sdk.so
```
